name: SVC_AP_ACT_CONDITIONS_INT
description: This table contains the definitions of conditions for the entity object of an action.

columns.name: ACTION_CONDITION_ID
columns.description: The data to this column is filled during enrichment.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: Foreign key that references SVC_AP_ACTIONS.ACTION_ID, the action whose object the condition is defined for.This will be enriched.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the condition for an action.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the condition for an action.

columns.name: CONDITION
columns.description: Expression that evaluates to true or false to indicate whether the condition is met or not.

columns.name: ACTION_STATUS_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the status to set an action to if the condition is met.

columns.name: COMPLETION_FLAG
columns.description: This flag indicates that the current condition when met would depict the completion of this action.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: For each run of the job, import wizard generates a new batch id and this batch id will be used uniquely.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Used to link this record with the error record.

columns.name: FILE_RECORD_NUM
columns.description: This column is required by import wizard to relate record in the interface table to the file row.

columns.name: ERROR_MESSAGE
columns.description: This is an optional column and would be useful if consumers want any error message as the first error.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This column indicates import wizard if the import to base table was successful or Erorred out.

columns.name: FILE_NAME_SYSTASK_ID
columns.description: This column is required for bulk import operations.

columns.name: ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Action code will be used to determine what operation should be done: insert,update,delete.

columns.name: INTERNAL_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Internal action code will be populated internally by framework based on outcome of match step.

columns.name: INTERNAL_OVN
columns.description: The Object Version Number of the record being updated. Used for Optimistic Locking as part of Incremental Update.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ACTION_OSR
columns.description: This is used for enriching the action id during import.
